ambient_chatter.text: anyone else hear the sacred chicken squawking at dawn? he is judging us xD
lag is so bad my horse is walking backwards :) bold strategy, not gonna lie
reminder that {village} is not a real village, it is a state of mind :)
the bridge has not paid its respects to me in weeks. i am considering legal action :(
if it rains on {town} one more time i'm filing a complaint with the sky. dont test me

ambient_brag.text: i have {troop_count} men and a sacred chicken. the enemy has a sad goose. guess who wins :)
just counted my {gold} gold twice. it still says {gold}. miracles xD
{fief} is mine now. the locals asked for a nickname so i gave them three. they hate it :)
marched {troop_count} soldiers into {fief} and nobody even blinked. very rude of them honestly
treasury says {gold} gold. my chicken says it wants a cut. negotiations ongoing xD

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat me with {troop_count} men and i am OUTRAGED. this is a loss, not a lesson :)
gg {player}, {troop_count} troops and you still didnt bring a chicken. amateur hour xD
ser {player} you absolutely cheated with that charge. i respect it. i hate it. ill be back :)
{player} lucky shot. the chicken saw everything and is not impressed by you
Well fought {player}! I lost {troop_count} lads to your banner, but I'm laughing too hard to be mad. Rematch at the crossroads?

beat_player.text: {player} went down in a field battle and the chicken is doing a victory lap. no refunds :)
{player} lost {troop_count} troops and {gold} gold to me. you're welcome for the lesson :)
ser {player} that was a great fight. i took {gold} gold off you, sorry not sorry :) rematch soon
{player} your banner looked great in the mud. the mud looked better xD
Good ride, {player}. I've got {gold} of your gold and your {troop_count} lads are now my new cheering section. Hope you like chickens.

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} saw my banner and ran off like the sacred chicken just stole their lunch xD
{player} fled the field before i even got my boots on. honestly rude, i was going to be so nice
ser {player} running from me? i'm wounded. i'll be waiting at the bridge with a bad joke :)
fleeing again {player}? bold of you to assume the bridge lets you pass for free
{player} took off so fast they dropped a glove. i am keeping the glove. it is evidence :)

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won like nine fights in a row. i'm starting a fund for the losers. it's me. i'm the losers xD
{player} keeps winning and i keep blaming the horse. the horse is innocent. mostly.
ser {player} at this point the whole server is watching you. i'm proud and a little jealous :)
keep winning {player}, the chicken is writing a list of who's next and you're on it :)
everyone is talking about {player}'s streak. i'm just here for the tavern drama xD

peace_made.text: {my_faction} signed peace with {faction} and i am legally required to bring snacks to the signing :)
peace between {my_faction} and {faction}? i give it a week before somebody steals a goat xD
{faction} and {my_faction} shook hands. my sacred chicken refused to attend, out of principle
ok {faction}, you're tolerated again. dont make me regret this ceasefire :)

war_declared.text: {my_faction} has declared war on {enemy_faction}. i already named their horses. all terrible names :)
war on {enemy_faction}?? wonderful. bringing the chicken and a truly unhinged battle speech xD
{enemy_faction} wants a fight with {my_faction}. great, they can have the mud, we're keeping the snacks :)
officially at war with {enemy_faction}. the dramatic lighting has been arranged :) dont ask who arranged it

encounter_greeting.text: Ho there {player}! It's {persona} of {my_faction}, sacred chicken escort and full-time menace. Care for a duel or a snack?
{player}, I see your banner. Fine colors, ser. My chicken has already judged them, so proceed with caution :)
{player}! {persona} of {my_faction} here, and I have not forgotten the mud incident. Draw your sword, you scoundrel xD
Oh hello {player}, {persona} here! Quick question: have you met the chicken guarding the bridge? He expects respect.
Halt, {player}! Whoever you are, you're trespassing on my mood. {persona} of {my_faction}, pleased to not meet you.

whisper_taunt.text: {player} your last battle plan was a sad goose honking at a wall :)
{player}, {rival} is hiding behind a horse and i respect the strategy. you should try it xD
still think you can beat me {player}? the chicken already drafted your loss speech :)
{player} i've been thinking about your horse all morning. i have questions. and a sword
gonna need a bigger army {player}, the bridge is watching and it is not impressed xD
